metricValue.description: The score produced by an {@link MlScoringMetric} for a given {@link MlModel} and input data.

error.description: This field is populated if there was any error raised during the calculation of the monitor metric value.

title:
{@link MlModel.Monitor.Value} represents the result of a single {@link MlScoringMetric} calculation for a {@link MlModel}
for a specific data filter for a point in time.
This is primarily used as part of {@link MlModel.Monitor.TimedResult}, which is primarily produced by
{@link MlModel.Monitor.Job} and {@link MlModel.Monitor.BatchResult}.
name: MlModel.Monitor.Value
